memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Generalised anxiety disorder and rheumatoid arthritis.
Patient reports persistent worry, muscle tension, and joint stiffness especially in mornings. Exam shows mild tachycardia, tender swollen MCP and PIP joints bilaterally, no synovial warmth. Spirometry performed: FEV1 2.8 L (92% predicted), FVC 3.2 L, FEV1/FVC 0.88; change since prior test not applicable. Smoking status: never. Inhaler technique: not applicable. Asthma Control Test not applicable.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
escitalopram 5 mg OD
buspirone 5 mg BD
methotrexate 10 mg once weekly
folic acid 5 mg once weekly
hydroxychloroquine 200 mg OD
prednisolone 5 mg OD

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Generalised anxiety disorder partially controlled; rheumatoid arthritis active.
Patient notes reduced worry but still reports fatigue and morning stiffness lasting >1 hour. Joint exam: swelling and tenderness in wrists and MCP joints, mild synovial thickening. Spirometry: FEV1 2.9 L (95% predicted), FVC 3.3 L, FEV1/FVC 0.88; ΔFEV1 +0.1 L since last test. Smoking status: never. Inhaler technique: not applicable. Asthma Control Test not applicable.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
methotrexate increased to 15 mg once weekly
folic acid unchanged 5 mg once weekly
 hydroxychloroquine unchanged 200 mg OD
prednisolone tapered to 7.5 mg OD
escitalopram unchanged 5 mg OD
buspirone unchanged 5 mg BD

memories.author: patient
memories.text: I’ve been feeling nauseous after taking methotrexate on Mondays, and my stomach feels upset. The anxiety is better but I still get occasional palpitations.

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Refer to Rheumatology for evaluation of persistent rheumatoid arthritis activity despite methotrexate 15 mg weekly and low-dose prednisolone. Request advice on disease-modifying therapy optimisation and possible biologics.

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Rheumatology review: patient continues to have active synovitis; recommend adding sulfasalazine 500 mg BD and consider tapering prednisolone further. Continue methotrexate 15 mg weekly with folic acid. Repeat labs in 4 weeks.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Generalised anxiety disorder well controlled; rheumatoid arthritis showing improvement after sulfasalazine initiation.
Patient reports worry minimal, GAD-7 5. Joint exam: reduced swelling, tenderness mild in wrists. Spirometry: FEV1 3.0 L (98% predicted), FVC 3.4 L, FEV1/FVC 0.88; ΔFEV1 +0.1 L. Smoking status: never. Inhaler technique: not applicable. Asthma Control Test not applicable.
